argv: F=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; eval "$(grep -E "^(PIN|REV)_(JS|BASH|TSUKUROI|MADO|CHECKLIST|CLAIMS)=" tools/mutate-and-run.sh)"; reading() { r=""; [ "$1" = "$2" ] || r=stale; if [ "$2" != "$3" ] || [ -n "$4" ]; then r="${r:+$r + }drift"; fi; echo "${r:-current}"; }; echo "host=$(hostname) now=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; echo "== falsifier (tick substrate = js-kimi-census blob at recorded live-HEAD 175de6ba, clean per record):"; s=$(git -C $F/kumitate-shokunin show 175de6ba2e9e904010411b19cab27e0af9aad3d4:scripts/kimi-census.mjs | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); echo "  as recorded  pin=${PIN_JS:0:8} live=${s:0:8} -> $(reading $PIN_JS $s $s "")"; echo "  falsifier    pin=${PIN_TSUKUROI:0:8} live=${s:0:8} -> $(reading $PIN_TSUKUROI $s $s "")"; echo "== re-sweep now (pinned: HEAD shown per repo; read-only):"; row() { g="git -C $F/$2 --no-optional-locks"; h=$($g rev-parse HEAD); $g merge-base --is-ancestor "$5" "$h" && a=yes || a=no; lv=$(sha256sum "$F/$2/$3" | cut -d" " -f1); hb=$($g show "$h:$3" | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); st=$($g status --porcelain -- "$3"); printf "  %-22s HEAD=%s anc=%s pin=%s live=%s HEADblob=%s porcelain=[%s] -> %s\n" "$1" "${h:0:12}" "$a" "${4:0:8}" "${lv:0:8}" "${hb:0:8}" "$st" "$(reading $4 $lv $hb "$st")"; }; row js-kimi-census kumitate-shokunin scripts/kimi-census.mjs $PIN_JS $REV_JS; row bash-surface-census kagi-shokunin corpus/surface-census.sh $PIN_BASH $REV_BASH; row bash-tsukuroi-census tsukuroi-shokunin tools/tsukuroi-census.sh $PIN_TSUKUROI $REV_TSUKUROI; row bash-mado-verify mado-shokunin tools/mado-verify.sh $PIN_MADO $REV_MADO; row kagi-checklist-run kagi-shokunin corpus/checklist-run.sh $PIN_CHECKLIST $REV_CHECKLIST; row kumitate-claims-check kumitate-shokunin scripts/claims-check.mjs $PIN_CLAIMS $REV_CLAIMS
